name: Teamwork Graph CLI
desc: CLI that pipes Atlassian work context into any AI agent.
desc_zh: 把 Atlassian 工作上下文送进任意 AI 智能体的命令行工具
solves: Coding agents stitch Jira, Confluence and Bitbucket APIs together one call at a time. This CLI hands them the joined-up graph in one query, with fewer tokens.
solves_zh: 编码智能体得一次次调用 Jira、Confluence、Bitbucket 的接口才能拼出上下文。这个命令行工具一次查询就把打通的工作图谱交给它，token 也用得更省。
best_for: You point Claude Code or Cursor at a ticket and want it to already know the linked spec, branch and reviewer.
best_for_zh: 你让 Claude Code 或 Cursor 去处理一张工单，希望它已经知道关联的文档、分支和评审人。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.atlassian.com/blog/company-news archive (Team '26 and post-Team ）。 Announced in open beta at Team '26 on 2026-05-06 and generally available on 2026-07-07; the same post has since been updated with a GA banner, so the 2026-05-06 body text is the open-beta wording. The CLI's own repo is https://github.com/atlassian/twg-cli. No media source was read. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.atlassian.com/blog/company-news/teamwork-graph-team-26
